long_description: Dawako Medtech develops a wireless wearable ultrasound patch (multi-modal ultrasound plus muscle-activation and oxygenation sensing). It pairs the patch with the PiiXMED cloud platform, which uses proprietary AI to extract quantitative imaging biomarkers. Its customers are healthcare professionals, sports-science and physiotherapy teams, and clinical researchers (CROs). It uses a Medical Device-as-a-Service model. The company was founded in 2018 at the University of Valencia Science Park and had about 20 employees by the end of 2023. PitchBook lists about $3.09M raised from investors including Red.es, INNVIERTE, the Valencian Innovation Agency and BeAble Capital. CB Insights lists $1.85M.

long_description: DataJoint makes software that operates some of the world’s most complex research, like MICrONS, the $100-million “Apollo Project for the Brain.” Our technology has cracked the problem of making data-intensive science reproducible. Today our platform operates computational pipelines for neuroscience labs at a dozen institutions including Harvard Medical School, UCSF, Johns Hopkins, and the National Eye Institute at NIH. We’re leading a transformation in the scientific method itself — a paradigm shift we call “SciOps.” Like GitHub and AWS did for software development, we aim to transform scientific research, as the foundation layer that opens up entirely new categories of products and services. We’ll bring AI into the research loop, accelerate cures for Alzehimer’s and other diseases, and power a new category of AI-enhanced diagnostics and devices.

long_description: Deckard Technologies is a GovTech data company founded in 2018 and based in San Diego, California. The company specializes in AI-driven analytics and data solutions for local governments, focusing on residential property oversight, including short-term rentals, long-term rentals, and foreclosures. With a global presence that includes offices in Colombia and Australia, Deckard serves over 400 jurisdictions worldwide. The company's flagship product, Rentalscape, is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform that automates the monitoring and compliance tracking of rental properties. It analyzes millions of listings in real time, ensuring accurate property matching and compliance detection. Deckard also provides tools for revenue optimization, helping governments capture taxes from unregistered rentals and maintain community standards. Their services include analytical reporting and data visualization, transforming raw data into actionable insights for local governments.

long_description: Dexter Energy is a climate technology company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands, founded in 2017. The company focuses on AI-driven solutions for the energy sector, aiming to accelerate the transition to a renewable, carbon-free power system. With a team of approximately 90 to 107 employees, Dexter Energy serves clients across nine European countries, utilizing machine learning, data analytics, and energy meteorology to enhance forecasting and optimization for renewable energy assets like wind, solar, and battery storage. The company's core offerings include an AI-based forecasting platform that provides accurate short-term forecasts for energy generation and prices, helping clients reduce costs and maximize revenues in volatile markets. Dexter Energy also offers trade optimization software and portfolio management tools, enabling energy companies to better manage their renewable assets. With a recent Series C funding round raising €23 million, Dexter Energy is well-positioned to expand its services and continue driving innovation in the energy sector.
